params.body:
Follow-up on #118, from a look at the live panel: three lines in three sizes and three colours under the logo was not a stack any more.

- The two calls stay as page 4 of the maquette draws them, the same size, the first dark green and the second white.
- The door for a member ("Sign in", or the member's name) sits small in the top corner of the mint panel.
- The serif menu gets the width for two rows (it broke into three at 1440).

BRAND.md notes the reason.
params.title: Sign in leaves the stack of calls
